en-us.otaku_boardgames_initial: A board game sits on the table with its rulebook open beside it.
en-us.otaku_boardgames_join: $joining.name$ takes a seat at the game table and opens the rulebook.
en-us.otaku_boardgames_late: $joining.name$ reaches the game table a little later and looks over the layout.
en-us.otaku_boardgames_shared_initial: $attendees.name$ try a few practice moves, pausing to check unclear rules together. Each person makes their own decisions on their turn, without anyone taking over. This practice is not scored.
en-us.otaku_boardgames_shared_arrival: $companions.name$ explain the current layout to $joining.name$ and make room for a practice turn. They take turns and check questions together, without rushing anyone or counting a winner.
en-us.otaku_boardgames_finish: The rulebook remains open beside the board. The reserved game session is not over.
